technical.summary: Long-term uptrend structure intact but short-term momentum severely compromised; oversold conditions lack confirmation signals and price remains below key moving averages, making this a poor swing entry despite macro bullish backdrop.

fundamental.summary: EIX shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 1 day creates elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (18/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional signal and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (440.0), flat yield curve, rising dollar, FOMC in 2 days, and earnings binary event in 1 day create a highly adverse macro and event-driven risk environment for EIX.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term uptrend structure (EMA 50/200 and SMA 50/200 bullish) combined with extreme fear sentiment (18/100) and oversold RSI_9 creates a contrarian buy setup near support (56.17) ahead of potential relief rally.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary event in 1 day, VIX crisis regime (440.0), FOMC in 2 days, price below all key moving averages, negative MACD/CMF/OBV, death cross active, and zero technical confirmation signals make this an unacceptably high-risk entry with no margin of safety.

decision.entry_rationale: While long-term structure remains bullish and extreme fear presents contrarian opportunity, earnings binary event in 1 day combined with VIX crisis regime (440.0) and complete absence of short-term momentum confirmation create unacceptable risk/reward asymmetry for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 1 day will trigger binary volatility spike with price below all key moving averages and zero technical confirmation—downside risk far exceeds upside potential in current macro environment.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on high risk; debate decisively favors bear case (9 vs 3)
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 41 Utilities positions with existing EIX exposure; sector concentration and earnings proximity make this a poor allocation of capital and risk budget.
